info.title: Scouting Tenant Club API
info.description:
API for a club tenant (team roster, players, matches, scouting progress, subscription, packages, invoices).

Each club is served from its own host: `ahly.sportego.org` -> club `ahly` -> MongoDB database `ahly`.
The tenant is the first label before the dot, and every club has an isolated database.

On localhost, send the `x-subdomain` header or `?subdomain=ahly` instead of using a subdomain.

Every successful response uses the envelope `{ success: true, message?, data }`. Lists return `data.items` + `data.pagination`.

servers.description: Local Development Server (use 'x-subdomain' header or ?subdomain= for tenant routes)

subdomain.description: Club subdomain identifier (also the database name)

SuperAdminAuth.description: Super Admin JWT token returned from POST /api/auth/login

TenantAuth.description: Tenant JWT token returned from POST /api/tenant/auth/login

TenantSubdomain.name: x-subdomain
TenantSubdomain.description: Club subdomain (e.g. 'ahly'). Optional in production: the tenant is taken from the host (`ahly.sportego.org`). Required on localhost or when calling the API from the apex domain.

BadRequest.description: Validation error or invalid request body

Forbidden.description: The resource belongs to another club

error.message: This order belongs to another club

Conflict.description: Business rule conflict (e.g. record is referenced by other data, or it is the last active admin)

error.message: Cannot delete this match: 3 player-progress row(s) reference it

get.description: Checks server status, uptime, and database connectivity

post.description: Authenticates a club admin/coach/viewer against this club's isolated database. Send `password` plus **one of** `email`, `phone` or `identifier` (identifier can be either an email or a phone number). Inactive accounts get 401.

parameters.name: x-subdomain
parameters.description: Club subdomain. Optional when the request already targets `ahly.sportego.org`.

get.description: Returns the signed-in admin together with the club summary and subscription status.

put.description: 400 if the current password is wrong or the new password equals the current one. Changing the password revokes every previously issued tenant token (`password_version`).

post.description: Stateless logout; the client drops the tenant token.

get.description: Returns everything the tenant dashboard needs on initial load: signed-in admin, club profile, subscription status, database name, settings, and entity counts.

get.summary: Browse Available Packages to Buy / Renew
get.description: Returns all **active** packages (not paginated, newest first). Each cycle includes the computed `discount_amount` and `final_price`; `is_current` marks the club's current package. `players` = max players **per team**, `teams` = max teams.
404 when the package does not exist or is inactive.
Returns active payment methods (not paginated, sorted by name) where clubs can transfer subscription fees. `icon` is returned as an absolute URL.
Returns the orders placed by **this club only** (`club_id` is forced server-side), with `package_id` and `payment_method_id` populated.

post.description: Creates a **pending** central order for this club in one step and mirrors it into the club's cart collection as `checked_out` (with `order_id`). A late-renewal `fine` is added automatically when the subscription is in its late-renewal window. Payment proof is mandatory: upload a file (`image`/`file`) in a multipart request **or** send a `payment_proof` URL in JSON; an uploaded file wins over the URL. 404 if the package/cycle/payment method does not exist; 400 if the payment method is inactive or no proof is provided.

requestBody.description: Send JSON (with a `payment_proof` URL) or multipart/form-data (with an `image` file).

payment_proof.description: Image URL of the transfer receipt

image.description: Image file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, max 5MB). The server also accepts the field name `file`.

example.message: Package purchased successfully. Your order is pending super admin approval.

get.description: 403 if the order belongs to another club.

post.description: Replaces the receipt on an order and deletes the previous local file. 403 if the order belongs to another club.

image.description: Image file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, max 5MB). The server also accepts the field name `file`.

get.description: Returns structured invoice data for this club's order. Pass `?format=html` to get the printable HTML page instead of the JSON envelope.

200.description: Invoice JSON (default) or printable HTML when `?format=html`
Clean HTML invoice ready for print or saving as PDF

get.description: Each item is enriched with `package` (`name`, `game_id`, `teams`, `players`). This list has no `search` support.

post.description: Pricing (price/discount/months/cycle name) is resolved server-side from the package and cycle; the client never sends prices.

post.summary: Checkout the Whole Cart -> Pending Orders
post.description: Checks out **every** item currently in the cart (`status: cart`): creates one central `pending` order per item for super-admin review, then **removes those items from the cart**. The late-renewal fine (if any) is charged once, on the first order only. The subscription is extended only after the super admin approves the orders. 400 if the cart is empty, the payment method is inactive, or no payment proof is provided (upload a file in `image`/`file`, or send `payment_proof` URL). If creating an order fails, the orders created so far are rolled back.

requestBody.description: Send JSON (with a `payment_proof` URL) or multipart/form-data (with an `image` file).

payment_proof.description: Image URL of the transfer receipt

image.description: Image file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, max 5MB). The server also accepts the field name `file`.

example.message: Order created and sent to the super admin for review

post.description: Deletes every document whose id is in `ids`. 409 if any of them was already `checked_out`.

delete.description: Same handler as `POST /api/tenant/cart/bulk-delete`, kept for clients that prefer `DELETE`.

put.description: Only items still in `cart` status can be edited (409 otherwise). Sending `package_id` and/or `cycle_id` re-resolves the pricing.

delete.description: 409 if the item was already checked out.

post.summary: Upload Payment Proof for a Cart Item's Order
post.description: Attaches/replaces the receipt on the order linked to this cart item (`order_id`). 400 if the item has no order yet. Note: `order_id` is only set on items created by `POST /api/tenant/orders` (direct purchase); items checked out through `POST /api/tenant/cart/checkout` are deleted from the cart, so use `POST /api/tenant/orders/{id}/payment-proof` for those.

image.description: Image file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, max 5MB). The server also accepts the field name `file`.

put.description: Replaces the previous logo and deletes the old local file when a new file is uploaded. 400 when nothing is sent. Also available as `POST` and `PATCH` on the same path.

requestBody.description: Send JSON (`logo` URL + colors) or multipart/form-data (logo file in `image`/`file` + colors). At least one field or a file is required.

get.description: Read-only list of platform games. Used to pick a game when creating a team.
Active games only, sorted by name.
Read-only list of platform actions (`game_id` is populated with its `name`). Used to record player progress.
Active actions only, sorted by name. `game_id` is the raw id here (not populated).

post.description: 400 if the club has no package, or the club already has the max number of teams (`package.teams`) **for this game**. 404 if the game does not exist.

put.description: Changing `game_id` also moves all the team's players to the new game. 404 if the team or game does not exist.

delete.description: 409 if the team has players or matches. Pass `?force=true` (or `1`, or `{ "force": true }` in the body) to cascade-delete its players, their progress, and its matches.

post.description: Deletes every document whose id is in `ids`. 409 if any team has players or matches (no `force` option in bulk).

delete.description: Same handler as `POST /api/tenant/teams/bulk-delete`, kept for clients that prefer `DELETE`.

get.description: `team_id` / `game_id` in the items are raw ids (not populated).

post.description: `game_id` is taken from the team; if you send it, it must match the team's game (400). 400 if the club has no package or the team already has `package.players` players. 404 if the team does not exist. The team's `players` counter is re-synced.

game_id.description: Optional - must equal the team's game

put.description: Moving a player to another team (`team_id`) also updates `game_id` and enforces the destination team's player limit (400). `game_id` can't be changed on its own (must match the team's game). Both teams' `players` counters are re-synced.

delete.description: 409 if player-progress rows reference this player.

post.description: Deletes every document whose id is in `ids`. 409 if player-progress rows reference any of them.

delete.description: Same handler as `POST /api/tenant/players/bulk-delete`, kept for clients that prefer `DELETE`.

get.description: `team_id`, `team1_id` and `team2_id` are populated with `name`. `?from=` / `?to=` filter on the match `date`.

post.description: Two formats: our team vs an external opponent (`team1_id` [or legacy `team_id`] + `opponent_name`), or two internal teams (`team1_id` + `team2_id`; `opponent_name` is then ignored). 404 if any selected team does not exist.

get.summary: Players' Actions Summary for All Matches
get.description: For every match: each player with the number of times each action was recorded. Not paginated. Must be registered before `/matches/{id}`.

put.description: Sending `team1_id`/`team_id` updates both fields. 404 if a team does not exist.

delete.description: 409 if player-progress rows reference this match.

get.summary: Players' Actions Summary for One Match
get.description: Each player in the match with the count of every recorded action (rows whose player or action was deleted are skipped).

post.description: Deletes every document whose id is in `ids`. 409 if player-progress rows reference any of them.

delete.description: Same handler as `POST /api/tenant/matches/bulk-delete`, kept for clients that prefer `DELETE`.

get.description: `match_id`/`player_id`/`action_id` are raw ids; each item is enriched with `action` (`name`, `game_id`) and `player` (`name`, `team_id`). `?from=`/`?to=` filter by the linked match's date. No `search` support.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter by the linked match's date (on/after)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter by the linked match's date (on/before)

post.summary: Record Player Action Event in Match
post.description: Validates that the match, player and action exist (404), that the action belongs to the player's game (400), and that the player's team played this match (400).

get.description: Aggregates progress events, optionally filtered by `player_id`, `match_id`, `action_id` and a date range (`?from=&to=` on the linked match's date). Returns total events, counts per action, and a per-player breakdown. Must be registered before `/player-progress/{id}`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter by the linked match's date (on/after)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter by the linked match's date (on/before)

put.description: Missing fields fall back to the current values, then the same cross-checks as create are applied.

post.description: Deletes every document whose id is in `ids`.

delete.description: Same handler as `POST /api/tenant/player-progress/bulk-delete`, kept for clients that prefer `DELETE`.

get.description: The list is returned twice for backward compatibility: `data.admins` and `data.items` are identical.

post.description: 409 if the email or phone already exists.

get.description: Active admins only, sorted by name.

put.description: Rules: you can't deactivate yourself or change your own role (400); email/phone must stay unique (409); the club must always keep at least one active admin (409). Changing `password` revokes the user's old tokens.

delete.description: 400 if you try to delete yourself; 409 if it is the last active admin of the club.

post.description: Deletes every document whose id is in `ids`. 400 if `ids` contains your own id; 409 if the deletion would leave the club without an active admin.

delete.description: Same handler as `POST /api/tenant/admins/bulk-delete`, kept for clients that prefer `DELETE`.

post.description: Stores the image and returns its public URL.
